sub_sector.value: liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry instruments; thermal analysis; lab software

manufacturing_type.detail: Assembles analytical instruments; makes chromatography columns and consumables at own chemical manufacturing facilities.

production_model.detail: Instruments built per customer orders; consumables, columns and standards stocked and sold online.

product_complexity.detail: High-performance chromatography and mass spectrometry systems for regulated, high-volume testing.

production_role.detail: Sells finished analytical systems and software, plus consumables like columns and reagents, to laboratories.

end_market_exposure.detail: Pharmaceutical and biopharma, clinical diagnostics, food and water safety, materials testing, environmental and academic research.
